xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4543: pan close refuses landed, deployed issues: deploy probe times out on a stalled event loop; stale 'running' verification artifact blocks row 3

plan.title: pan close refuses landed, deployed issues: deploy probe times out on a stalled event loop; stale 'running' verification artifact blocks row 3
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan close refused 8 landed, deployed issues on 2026-10-04 for two non-DoD reasons. Row 8 (deploy) probes /api/health once with a 3 s timeout, and the dashboard event loop stalled 4-5 s right after each successful close-out. Row 3 (verification) treats a stale 'running' verification-latest.json as a miss: a duplicate verification run finished its gates, hit the post-gate merged-skip in verification-runner.ts (line 592), and returned before the terminal artifact write, leaving 'running' on disk forever.
narratives.Proposal: Retry the deploy health probe 3 times (5 s timeout, 2 s pause) via a new dod-deploy-probe.ts module; let row 3 settle a missing OR non-terminal artifact when landed work and main CI are green, saying so in the observed text; add a 'skipped' artifact outcome and make the merged-skip path rewrite a still-running latest artifact to 'skipped' (latest-only, never over a real verdict); render 'skipped' in the Lint node and gates panel; profile the post-close-out event-loop stall without restarting the dashboard and fix it or file a follow-up; document rows 3 and 8 in MERGE-WORKFLOW.md and fix the pan-close skill's row numbers. Full detail: .pan/drafts PRD for PAN-4543.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the verification runner's infrastructure-error path (a non-merged error still leaves its last progress write)
- No per-run file for 'skipped' artifacts
- No change to row 3 handling of 'failed' artifacts
- No raise of any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row; verification-runner.ts stays at 961 lines and dod-gate.ts at or under 1000
- No dashboard restart, pan reload, pan up, or real pan close run by the work agent
- No change to which events trigger membership refreshes unless WI-7's profile proves a sync blocker there
- The post-deploy check (pan close PAN-4498 / PAN-4508 with no override) is operator/flywheel verification, not a work item
- No change to why deacon-lite re-requested verification at 05:06 (the duplicate run); this issue only makes such a run end in a terminal artifact
- No cleanup sweep of existing stale 'running' files in other workspaces; row 3's new rule settles them at close-out

autoDecisions.summary: Retry the deploy probe on any readJson rejection, not only timeouts
autoDecisions.rationale: Connection refused during a deploy restart and 5xx are as transient as a timeout; only three consecutive failures are a real signal. Worst case adds 19 s to a human-gated ceremony.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the retry loop in a new src/lib/lifecycle/dod-deploy-probe.ts using setTimeout
autoDecisions.rationale: dod-gate.ts is 988 lines against the 1000-line ceiling; setTimeout keeps the AC's fake-timer test straightforward; retryTransientForgeOp only retries forge errors.

autoDecisions.summary: Skipped artifact writes are latest-only and only replace a 'running' latest file
autoDecisions.rationale: Early merged-skip sites run before this run writes anything, so the latest file may hold a real earlier 'passed' that row 3 relies on; verification-cycles counts only failed per-run files.

autoDecisions.summary: Finalize call lives in skipMergedVerification behind an optional workspacePath
autoDecisions.rationale: verification-runner.ts is at its 961-line allowlist cap, so call sites change in place with zero net lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Profile the stall by opening the inspector on the running dashboard (kill -USR1) and re-sending the close-out refresh for an already-closed issue
autoDecisions.rationale: A restart with --cpu-prof is a deploy that non-flywheel agents must not do, and running pan close on a real issue is irreversible; re-sending an already-recorded event creates no new state.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep 'pan close PAN-4498/PAN-4508 completes without overrides' as post-deploy verification, not an item AC
autoDecisions.rationale: It needs the merged build deployed and it closes real tracker issues with no dry run, so the work agent cannot satisfy it.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the pan-close skill's row numbering (deploy is row 8, add ship row 7) in the docs item
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the same documentation surface the change touches and the drift would mislead operators reading the new retry text.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 in .pan/drafts (PAN-4543). In src/lib/cloister/verification-artifact.ts widen VerificationArtifact.outcome to 'running' | 'passed' | 'failed' | 'skipped', add optional skipReason, and add exported markRunningVerificationArtifactSkipped(workspacePath, reason, now = new Date()) which rewrites verification-latest.json to outcome 'skipped' (skipReason set, ranAt = now, currentGate/currentGateOutput removed, gates kept) ONLY when the current latest file exists with outcome 'running'; otherwise it writes nothing and returns null. Latest file only, never a per-run file. Add three real-temp-dir tests to tests/unit/lib/cloister/verification-artifact.test.ts.

Leave the other 7 call sites with two arguments: before this run's own progress write the 'running' latest may belong to another run (PRD D4, critique response). narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-7 exactly. Run a 100 ms /api/health latency sampler, open the inspector on the RUNNING dashboard with kill -USR1 <pid> (never restart, reload, or pan up), and record a CDP CPU profile while triggering POST /api/pipeline/membership/refresh?project=overdeck (the operator Retry-membership route; never append an event via appendOnce or any event route), and passively during a natural operator/flywheel close-out. Identify the heaviest blocking frames. If the blocker is a sync child process or sync fs scan on a server-reachable path, convert it to async primitives with a unit test; otherwise file a follow-up with gh issue create. Record method, sampler numbers, file:line, and the fix commit or follow-up link in a '## Stall profile findings (PAN-4543 WI-7)' section of the existing PRD file (.pan/drafts/PAN-4543.md, or pan-4543.md if promotion renamed it; never create a second PRD file). Never run pan close on a real issue.
